clips.title: The story
paras: In the Stonetalon Mountains, goblin operatives seek Gerenzo's Mechanical Arm as proof while clearing out competition. Taken from rogue engineer Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle, the grafted limb marks his death.

Above Cragpool Lake, rogue engineer Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle grafted whirring gears and metal onto his failing body. The renegade gnome replaced his natural limbs with intricate machinery. Goblin tinker Ziz Fizziks seeks Gerenzo's elimination to impress his superiors, and this distinctive arm is the trophy he needs as indisputable proof of the engineer's death.
